title.zh: 沃伦·巴菲特生平时间线

description.en: Key events in Warren Buffett's life and career
description.zh: 沃伦·巴菲特生活和职业中的关键事件

event.en: Born in Omaha, Nebraska
event.zh: 出生于内布拉斯加州奥马哈

event.en: Bought first stock at age 11 (Cities Service Preferred)
event.zh: 11岁时买入第一只股票（城市服务优先股）

event.en: Entered University of Pennsylvania (Wharton)
event.zh: 进入宾夕法尼亚大学（沃顿商学院）

event.en: Transferred to University of Nebraska, graduated in 3 years
event.zh: 转入内布拉斯加大学，三年毕业

event.en: Earned Master's degree from Columbia Business School, studied under Benjamin Graham
event.zh: 从哥伦比亚商学院获得硕士学位，师从本杰明·格雷厄姆

event.en: Joined Graham-Newman Corp as securities analyst
event.zh: 加入格雷厄姆-纽曼公司担任证券分析师

event.en: Founded Buffett Partnership Ltd. with $105,000 from family and friends
event.zh: 创立巴菲特合伙有限公司，从家人和朋友处筹集105,000美元

event.en: Met Charlie Munger, beginning lifelong partnership
event.zh: 结识查理·芒格，开始终身合作

event.en: Began buying shares of Berkshire Hathaway, a struggling textile company
event.zh: 开始买入伯克希尔·哈撒韦股份，一家陷入困境的纺织公司

event.en: Took control of Berkshire Hathaway, became CEO
event.zh: 接管伯克希尔·哈撒韦，成为首席执行官

event.en: Acquired National Indemnity, entering insurance business
event.zh: 收购国民赔偿公司，进入保险业务

event.en: Dissolved Buffett Partnership, citing lack of value opportunities
event.zh: 解散巴菲特合伙公司，理由是缺乏价值投资机会

event.en: Acquired See's Candies for $25 million
event.zh: 以2500万美元收购喜诗糖果

timeline.note: Pivotal shift from cigar butts to quality businesses

event.en: First Berkshire Hathaway annual shareholder letter published
event.zh: 发布第一封伯克希尔·哈撒韦年度致股东信

event.en: Began investing in Coca-Cola, eventually becoming largest shareholder
event.zh: 开始投资可口可乐，最终成为最大股东

event.en: Berkshire Hathaway stock price reaches $7,455 per share
event.zh: 伯克希尔·哈撒韦股价达到每股7,455美元

event.en: Issued Berkshire B shares to allow smaller investors to participate
event.zh: 发行伯克希尔B股，允许小投资者参与

event.en: Announced pledge to give away 99% of fortune to philanthropy
event.zh: 宣布承诺将99%的财富捐献给慈善事业

event.en: Invested $5 billion in Goldman Sachs during financial crisis
event.zh: 金融危机期间投资50亿美元于高盛

event.en: Launched The Giving Pledge with Bill Gates
event.zh: 与比尔·盖茨共同发起捐赠誓言

event.en: Began major investment in Apple, eventually becoming largest shareholder
event.zh: 开始大举投资苹果，最终成为最大股东

event.en: Berkshire Hathaway market cap exceeds $800 billion
event.zh: 伯克希尔·哈撒韦市值超过8000亿美元

description.en: Formative years, early interest in business and investing
description.zh: 成长期，早期对商业和投资的兴趣

description.en: Learning value investing from Benjamin Graham
description.zh: 从本杰明·格雷厄姆学习价值投资
运营巴菲特合伙公司，卓越回报

description.en: Transforming Berkshire from textile to conglomerate
description.zh: 将伯克希尔从纺织厂转型为综合企业

description.en: Mature style: buying wonderful businesses at fair prices
description.zh: 成熟风格：以合理价格购买优秀企业

description.en: Focus on giving away fortune through Giving Pledge
description.zh: 通过捐赠誓言专注于捐赠财富
